rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for raising a level, amount, quality, or degree.

example.english: Daily practice can heighten your Cantonese proficiency.
example.traditional: 每日練習可以提高你嘅粵語水平。
example.jyutping: mui5 jat6 lin6 zaap6 ho2 ji5 tai4 gou1 nei5 ge3 jyut6 jyu5 seoi2 ping4

rows.note: Use this mainly for making a physical height or level higher, rather than for strengthening an effect.

example.english: This project will heighten the river embankment to reduce the risk of flooding.
example.traditional: 今次工程會將河堤升高，減低水浸風險。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 gung1 cing4 wui5 zoeng1 ho4 tai4 sing1 gou1 gaam2 dai1 seoi2 zam3 fung1 him2

rows.note: Use this when heightening means making an effect, force, feeling, or intensity stronger.

example.english: The dimmed lights heighten the tense atmosphere.
example.traditional: 燈光一暗，現場嘅緊張氣氛就加強咗。
example.jyutping: dang1 gwong1 jat1 am3 jin6 coeng4 ge3 gan2 zoeng1 hei3 fan1 zau6 gaa1 koeng4 zo2
